sourceBehavior.boundedReads: Execute only --version and --help with cwd /, PATH/LANG/LC_ALL fixed, timeouts capped at 2500 ms per invocation and bounded output. Output streams are parsed internally and never copied to the CheckView.
sourceBehavior.optionEvidence: Record only presence of --pgdata, --encoding, --locale, --data-checksums, --auth-local, --auth-host and --username in help output. This does not attest that an authentication method value is accepted.
sourceBehavior.acquisitionReceipt: Hash adjacent INSTALL_RECEIPT.json only when it is a regular non-symlink file within the resolved version directory and at most 65536 bytes; distinguish observed, absent, unmeasured, unreadable and invalid. No bottle identity is inferred.
sourceBehavior.publicReadback: Return only CheckViewV1 for service.postgres with a JSON descriptor under prerequisite and executable/receipt hashes under artifactDigests. State remains BLOCKED for service readiness in every outcome.
